fee_notes: Fee is calculated at $0.11 per person in the territory (500,000–700,000 people), typically ranging $55,000–$77,000. In the year ended December 31, 2025, actual fees ranged from $46,695 to $78,980 with an average of $64,734. Discounts available: 15% for honorably discharged veterans (VetFran), 10% for first responders, 10–50% Roll-In Discount based on gross sales of an existing business being merged, and 5–20% Multi-Unit Owner Discount based on years as a franchisee. Roll-In and First Responder discounts cannot be combined. Purchasing an existing Junk King franchise incurs no Initial Franchise Fee but requires a $3,000 non-refundable training fee. A separate $1,250 Software System Enrollment Fee is also required at signing.
raw_excerpt: Your Initial Franchise Fee depends on the number of persons that live in your Territory based on the most recently published data from the U.S. Census Bureau or such other source as we may indicate. The Initial Franchise Fee is calculated as $0. 11 (eleven cents) multiplied by the number of persons living in your Territory. As a Territory will contain between 500,000 and 700,000 people, the Initial Franchise Fee will typically range between $55,000 to $77,000. In the year ended December 31, 2025, the average initial franchise fee paid by JUNK KING franchisees was approximately $ 64,734 and the initial franchise fee paid during that period ranged from $46,695 to $78,980 based on the population in the territory purchased.
